```yaml
name: Validate OpenAPI Specs

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '**/openapi.yml'
      - '**/openapi-edge.yml'
      - '**/openapi-hyperloop.yml'
      - '**/envd.yaml'
      - '.github/workflows/validate-openapi.yml'
  workflow_call:

jobs:
  validate-openapi:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        spec:
          - name: openapi
            path: packages/api/openapi.yml
          - name: openapi-edge
            path: packages/api/openapi-edge.yml
          - name: openapi-hyperloop
            path: packages/api/openapi-hyperloop.yml
          - name: envd
            path: packages/envd/spec/envd.yaml
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install Redocly CLI
        run: npm install -g @redocly/cli

      - name: Create minimal redocly config
        run: |
          cat > redocly.yaml << EOF
          rules:
            no-unused-components: error
            no-ambiguous-paths: error
            no-path-trailing-slash: error
            no-empty-servers: error
            no-enum-type-mismatch: error
            no-scalar-resolved-in-a-map: error
            no-scalar-resolved-in-a-list: error
            no-example-missing-value-field: error
            no-example-value-and-externalValue: error
            no-invalid-schema-examples: error
            no-invalid-media-type-examples: error
            no-http-verbs-in-paths: warn
            no-identical-paths: error
            no-ambiguous-http-verbs-in-paths: error
            path-parameters-defined: error
            operation-2xx-response: error
            operation-4xx-response: warn
            operation-singular-tag: warn
            operation-tag-defined: error
            path-declaration-must-exist: error
            path-not-include-query: error
            path-parameters-defined: error
            info-description: warn
            info-contact: warn
            info-license: warn
            info-license-url: warn
            tag-description: warn
            tag-description-required: warn
            operation-description: warn
            operation-operationId: error
            operation-operationId-unique: error
            operation-operationId-url-safe: error
            operation-summary: warn
            operation-2xx-response: error
            operation-4xx-response: warn
            operation-singular-tag: warn
            operation-tag-defined: error

            no-invalid-media-type-examples: error

            no-empty-servers: error
            no-enum-type-mismatch: error
            no-scalar-resolved-in-a-map: error
            no-scalar-resolved-in-a-list: error
            no-http-verbs-in-paths: warn
            no-identical-paths: error
            no-ambiguous-http-verbs-in-paths: error
            path-parameters-defined: error
            operation-2xx-response: error
            operation-4xx-response: warn
            operation-singular-tag: warn
            operation-tag-defined: error
            path-declaration-must-exist: error
            path-not-include-query: error
            path-parameters-defined: error
            info-description: warn
            info-contact: warn
            info-license: warn
            info-license-url: warn
            tag-description: warn
            tag-description-required: warn
            operation-description: warn
            operation-operationId: error
            operation-operationId-unique: error
            operation-operationId-url-safe: error
            operation-summary: warn
          EOF

      - name: Validate ${{ matrix.spec.name }}
        run: redocly lint ${{ matrix.spec.path }} --config redocly.yaml
```
